name: neotui-workspace
description: Bun-first workspace for the NeoTui project.

scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run --workspaces --sequential typecheck
scripts.lint: bunx @biomejs/biome check .editorconfig .github/workflows apps/*/src apps/*/package.json apps/*/tsconfig.json bench biome.json bunfig.toml docs examples package.json packages/*/src packages/*/tests packages/*/package.json packages/*/tsconfig.json scripts skills tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format: bunx @biomejs/biome format --write .editorconfig .github/workflows apps/*/src apps/*/package.json apps/*/tsconfig.json bench biome.json bunfig.toml docs examples package.json packages/*/src packages/*/tests packages/*/package.json packages/*/tsconfig.json scripts skills tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json
scripts.bench:all: bun run bench && bun run bench:advanced && bun run bench:text
